The  correct alignment of a building  and  its windows to the  sun, 
in  order to exploit its beneficial effects or to provide protection 
against its excessive  heat,  is  decisive for the practicality of a 
building. Sunshine entering  all  rooms  in  the autumn and winter, 
and  in  the morning,  is  desirable. Sunshine at midday  and  in  the
